description: Get the on-chain voting record of Canton Super Validators: how many DSO governance votes each has cast, how often they voted for or against, how often they abstained, and the span of their participation. Use for 'how does Tradeweb vote', 'which SVs abstain most', 'who is most active in governance'. CCPEDIA-unique: derived from the full ledger vote history. Canton ecosystem only.

sv_name.description: Super Validator short name, e.g. "Tradeweb-Markets-1", "Digital-Asset-1", "Cumberland-1". Omit for all of them.

name: list_votes_by_sv
